privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.content:
Welcome to QwikConnect ("we", "our", or "us"). We are committed to safeguarding the privacy and personal data of our users, clients, and service providers across Nigeria. This Privacy Policy outlines our standards and practices in full accordance with the Nigeria Data Protection Act (NDPA) and the Nigeria Data Protection Regulation (NDPR).

1. Information We Collect

To provide reliable on-demand service connections and safe marketplace transactions, we collect the following categories of information:

  • Account & Contact Data: Full name, verified email address, phone number, profile photo, and password credentials.
  • Location & Delivery Address: City, state (e.g., Lagos, Abuja, Port Harcourt), street address, and service catchment area within Nigeria to match buyers with proximate service providers.
  • Service Provider Verification Data: Government-issued identification (National Identification Number [NIN], Voter's Card, or Driver's License), proof of address/utility bills, professional certifications, and trade credentials.
  • Payment & Transaction Information: Billing records, order history, and payout bank details. All card and bank payments are processed through CBN-licensed, PCI-DSS certified payment processors (such as Paystack and Flutterwave). QwikConnect never stores raw debit card numbers or CVV codes.
  • Communications & Feedback: Direct in-app chat messages, dispute tickets, ratings, and customer reviews.

2. How We Use Your Information

We process your personal data for clear, lawful, and specific purposes:

  • To facilitate service booking, provider matching, scheduling, and on-site order fulfillment.
  • To verify artisan identity, perform background safety assessments, and prevent fraudulent activity.
  • To hold escrow funds securely and disburse verified payouts to service providers upon order completion.
  • To send real-time notifications, booking updates, invoices, and essential account security alerts.
  • To comply with regulatory obligations under Nigerian law.

3. Sharing and Disclosure of Information

We do not sell or rent your personal information to third parties. We share your information strictly under the following circumstances:

  • Between Buyers and Providers: When a booking is confirmed, the assigned provider receives the customer's service address, contact name, and phone number solely to carry out the agreed service.
  • Licensed Service Partners: We work with trusted infrastructure providers, SMS gateways, and cloud hosting providers under binding data processing agreements.
  • Legal & Regulatory Authorities: We may disclose information if required to do so by applicable Nigerian law, court subpoena, or authorized law enforcement requests.

4. Data Security & Storage

We implement enterprise-grade technical and organizational security measures, including 256-bit SSL encryption, firewalls, and restricted database access controls. Your data is stored securely and retained only for as long as necessary to maintain your account and fulfill legal compliance.

5. Your Data Protection Rights

Under the Nigeria Data Protection Act, you possess the right to:

  • Request access to copies of personal data held about you.
  • Request rectification of inaccurate, incomplete, or outdated information.
  • Request erasure of your account and personal records, subject to statutory retention limits.
  • Object to or restrict specific processing operations, including promotional communications.

6. Contact Our Data Protection Team

For questions, privacy inquiries, or to exercise your statutory rights, please reach out to our Data Protection Officer at privacy@qixer.ng or contact our headquarters at 14 Broad Street, Lagos Island, Lagos, Nigeria.

terms.title: Terms and Conditions
terms.content:
Welcome to QwikConnect. These Terms and Conditions govern your access to and use of our web application, marketplace platform, and on-demand services across the Federal Republic of Nigeria. By registering, booking, or listing services on QwikConnect, you agree to be bound by these terms.

1. The QwikConnect Marketplace

QwikConnect operates as an interactive digital marketplace platform connecting clients ("Buyers") seeking home and office services with verified, independent professional artisans and service businesses ("Sellers" or "Providers"). QwikConnect provides the technology, scheduling, dispute mediation, and escrow payment processing that enables these connections.

Independent Contractor Relationship: Service providers are independent contractors and are not employees, agents, or joint venturers of QwikConnect. Providers retain full discretion over their schedules, workmanship, and service execution.

2. Account Registration & Identity Verification

  • You must be at least 18 years old and legally competent to enter into binding agreements in Nigeria.
  • Users agree to provide true, accurate, and current information during registration.
  • Artisan Verification: All providers must complete identity verification by submitting a valid Nigerian government-issued ID (NIN, Driver's License, or Voter's Card) and verifiable address proof before receiving featured bookings and payout privileges.
  • You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account password and for all activities conducted under your credentials.

3. Service Bookings, Escrow & Payment Terms

  • Currency: All marketplace transactions, quotes, and service fees are denominated and charged in Nigerian Naira (₦).
  • Escrow Protection: When a buyer books a service, payment is authorized and held securely in escrow. Funds are disbursed to the service provider only after the buyer confirms satisfactory completion or the standard review window elapses without dispute.
  • Prohibition of Off-Platform Payments: To protect escrow safety and warranty guarantees, all payments for services initiated on QwikConnect must be processed through the platform. Requesting or paying offline to bypass marketplace fees is strictly prohibited and constitutes grounds for account termination.

4. Cancellations, Rescheduling & Refunds

  • Buyer Cancellations: A buyer may cancel a booking without penalty up to 4 hours before the scheduled appointment. Cancellations made after the provider has dispatched may incur a nominal mobilization fee.
  • Provider Cancellations: If a provider cancels or fails to arrive, the buyer is entitled to either an immediate full refund or a priority reassignment to another verified provider in their locality.
  • Quality Guarantee & Rework: If a service does not meet agreed specifications, the buyer must raise a report within 48 hours of service completion. The provider will be given an opportunity to rectify the work, or the dispute will proceed to our mediation team for refund determination.

5. Marketplace Code of Conduct

All users agree to uphold mutual respect, professional courtesy, and safe working conditions. Users may not:

  • Submit false, misleading, defamatory, or fraudulent reviews or dispute claims.
  • Subject any user or service provider to discrimination, verbal harassment, or unsafe job environments.
  • Post illicit, hazardous, or prohibited service listings under Nigerian law.

6. Dispute Mediation & Governing Law

In the event of a disagreement regarding service quality or payments, both parties agree to submit to QwikConnect's administrative dispute resolution process before seeking external legal remedies. These Terms are governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the Federal Republic of Nigeria.

7. Contact Information

For questions regarding these Terms or platform operations, please reach our administrative team at support@qixer.ng or visit our office at 14 Broad Street, Lagos Island, Lagos, Nigeria.
